connector.name: Canvas MCP by admin978
connector.registryDescription: Local-first MCP server for Canvas LMS. Stdio transport, no third-party broker.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package canvas-local-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the admin978 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
env.description: Canvas institution root URL (no /api/v1 suffix), e.g. https://your-institution.instructure.com

env.name: CANVAS_TOKEN
env.description: Canvas personal access token (Account -> Settings -> Approved Integrations -> New Access Token)
